$comment: The pixel-grid texture, as geometry. Source of truth for every export — run `npm run texture -- --help`. Units are layout px; an export at @2x doubles them. Measured from Figma node 435:2744 (a shader effect on a 30% layer, over paper): every 5x5 block of the render is identical, and each row of the 3px column carries its own alpha — two dashes, a fainter seam between them, fainter caps above and below. That row structure is what makes it read as an LCD column rather than as dashes, so it is kept; only a ~3% side fringe was dropped. Alphas already include the 30% layer. Colour is the only thing a use may vary.
name: pixel-grid
